idea-plugin.name: Terminal Safety Rails
idea-plugin.description:
Terminal Safety Rails

Detects dangerous commands in your IDE terminal and shows a warning/confirmation dialog before execution. Protects against accidental rm -rf /, kubectl delete on production, terraform destroy, docker system prune, and more.

Features

  • Command interception — catches dangerous commands before they execute
  • Risk levels — 🔴 CRITICAL, 🟠 HIGH, 🟡 MEDIUM, 🟢 LOW
  • Confirmation dialog — color-coded warning with command details
  • Built-in rules — 15+ dangerous command patterns out of the box
  • Custom rules — add your own patterns via settings
  • Team rules — share rules via .terminal-safety-rules.yaml

Part of DevOps Safety Kit

Pairs with Kubernetes Context Guard for comprehensive protection against accidental production changes.
